_two_gates_that_are_new: G-ALPHA and G-MP-STRUCT guard the two defects only a multipoint item can carry. G-ALPHA is the important one: a scenario wired to the wrong angle passes EVERY band, because the FD table and the adjoint are both taken at the same wrong angle. Comparator leg E-MP4 PROVES this -- it builds a fixture with point0 one whole degree off and requires G5_fd to read PASS while G-ALPHA reads GATE FAIL. A gate whose necessity is only argued is not shown to be necessary.
_the_two_checks_that_are_the_supervisors: (1) THE PRE-REGISTRATION COMMITTED BEFORE COMPUTE -- re-derive prereg_commit and confirm d19m_grade.py hashes to f1f78bf4e78072057dc13e25cf1ffda9 at it. (2) THE GRADER READ AS A DIFF -- d19m_grade.py is DERIVED from d19o_grade.py, so a diff against that file is the efficient read. The parts that are NOT a rename: read_X and read_F (rewritten for J and the three per-scenario CL), g_fd (grades J plus three CL), g_tb (grades J), g_alpha and g_mp_struct (NEW), ctrl_X / ctrl_F (new artefact shapes), ctrl_alphas (NEW), and the row and item composition (G-MP-STRUCT participates in the row; G-ALPHA is a hard item gate).
